analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free is caused by explicitly calling `fScratchGlyphRun.~SkGlyphRun()` in `SkGlyphRunBuilder::initialize()` without reconstructing/resetting the object before later use. `SkCanvas::onDrawText()` calls `drawText()` (which calls `initialize()`), then `useGlyphRun()`, then `drawGlyphRun()`. The glyph run still contains/may expose destroyed `SkPaint` state (including a color filter pointer), which is later dereferenced in GPU text path (`GrTextUtils::Paint::initFilteredColor` -> `SkColorFilter::filterColor4f`), producing UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via `api_mock_gpu_canvas` when fuzzed draw-text operations create a paint with a color filter and then execute the glyph-run text path. Data flow: fuzzer input -> `fuzz_canvas`/`fuzz_paint` sets `SkPaint` color filter -> `SkCanvas::drawText` -> `SkGlyphRunBuilder::drawText` -> `initialize()` destroys previous scratch glyph run -> subsequent `useGlyphRun()`/`drawGlyphRun()` consumes stale/destroyed run paint state; GPU text rendering dereferences freed color filter. No special input length is required (PoC length 0 still drives deterministic fuzz command stream).
